text:
support-bot: New cluster detected: 3 incoming tickets referencing 'tenant-level rate limit' from support and sales. Links: https://tickets/INC-4321, https://tickets/INC-4334, https://tickets/INC-4356. Suggested action: consider merge into canonical request and update requesters.

sam: noted. Is this the same ask as last quarter's 'tenant rate limit per-tenant config'?

julie: looks aligned but callers mention different causes (API throttling vs UI errors). I'd lean merge but keep per-issue notes.

mike_p: agree. Proposal: create canonical issue, tag with `dupe:merged`, `prio:high-customer`, `origin:support-sales` and link originals. Then notify requesters with template.

nate: +1. What's the owner? @sam or @julie?

sam: I can own the canonicalization this sprint. Will do a quick spec: runtime config + UI flag + rollout plan.

emily: thanks. Can we also add 'external_impact' field so sales has talking points? Example template:

```
Customer: {tenant}
Impact: token throttles during peak ingestion
Suggested ETA: 2 sprints
Workaround: backoff/retry
```

mike_p: sweet. For backlog triage, let's set score = 25 (customer size + severity). Add to next groom.

julie: On customer comms — please CC original sales rep and include manual status updates at 3, 10, 30 days.

sam: drafting PRD now. I'll include acceptance criteria: reproduce with load test, config toggle, metrics + rollback plan. Ping when ready for review.

support-bot: Noted. Ticket INC-4321 -> linked to canonical issue PF-982. Notifications queued.

nate: will update sales with short blurb. lemme know when PRD is up so i can attach to customer threads.

emily: small ask: add a tag `needs-legal-review` if customer data residency is mentioned. saw one mention.

sam: noted and added to PRD checklist.

julie: great. thanks team. I'll own the customer update cadence until resolved. :thumbsup:

mike_p: closing loop here. after merge, we run a quick eval to ensure we didn't over-prioritize similar non-impactful asks.

sam: PRD link: https://redwood.infra/s/pf-982-prd — will post update later today.

support-bot: update: notifications sent to requesters for PF-982.
